acc.hintPlan: Today's Plan counts this as about {h}.
acc.how: Studyboard also learns your pace. Once you have finished a few tasks it allows for how long your estimates really turn out to take (by kind of task, and by course when there is enough history), gently matches how much it plans each day to what you actually get done, and starts tasks a little sooner if you usually finish close to the deadline. Nothing changes until there are several tasks to learn from, and you can turn this off in Settings.
